detail.longDescription:
As a thought worker and a contractor, I sometimes think about how experience changed my approach to work. For fun, I boiled it down to three levels of proficiency:

Amateur: doesn't exhaust the details, works with a lot of guesswork, curveballs ruin the end result

Professionalist: exhausts the details, rarely guesses, curveballs can be damaging to end result

Expert: exhausts the details, rarely guesses, handling curveballs is part of the process

#Freelance #WebDevelopment #Research
